SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

3. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

8. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.

15. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

16. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
